subject: Re: B2:POI BC
author: ZombieTron
body: I really hope they do make Burnout 2 compatible on 360 as well. I wasn't expecting to see either of the first 2 Burnouts on the 360. But I think it is a good thing as it means gamers of the 360 generation will be able to see the history of Burnout for themselves without having to buy retro hardware ;-)

subject: What about Burnout 2 Point of Impact?
author: SUFFUR
body: Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: Minor Problem with Burnout on 360
author: ZombieTron
body: I have been playing through Burnout again as it is BC now but playing it on the 360 is not perfect. After a few races the sound effects fade away leaving only the music and dudes voice. No engine noise or Crashtastic sounds! It is easily enough fixed by jumping back to the dash and reloading, but I hope they do an update for it soon!
